data.exact_reserve_text: The adverse impacts to the underwriting result were partially offset by a release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (2016, GBP 57.6m release). This release is a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in Ogden discount rate decreased discount tables; reserves held on the 2014 and prior years of account relating to UK Motor Treaty business were adversely impacted, resulting in a strengthening to prior year losses.

data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2017 the Syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,103.264m. During 2017 the Syndicate reported a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m driven by favourable claims development and efficient claims handling. Offsetting events included a GBP 52.4m strengthening of prior year losses due to the Ogden discount rate change impacting 2014 and prior UK Motor Treaty reserves, and GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses in H2 2017 (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico City earthquake, California wildfires, Nate and others) which materially impacted the underwriting result. Overall, the prior year movement reported is a net release (after reinsurance); no gross prior-year movement figure was explicitly provided in the notes, so the published net release figure has been used.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (gross PYD) was not explicitly provided in the technical reserves movement note. The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 59.2m (after reinsurance) which has been used as the prior_year_development_gbp_m with a data quality caveat. The Ogden discount rate change and RITC from Syndicate 1400 (accepted 1 January 2016) are present in notes and may distort development tables; a gross claims development triangle is present but includes RITC effects, so the gross triangle was not used to compute PYD as primary source was unavailable. All monetary figures are reported in millions GBP (converted from GBP '000).
